description: Average over only the order items that have invoice line items.

b.request: For order items that have at least one invoice line item, calculate the average of derived_product_cost ÷ derived_total_cost across their invoice line items (excluding nulls) and count their invoice line items; return one row with the overall average of those per-item ratios and the average count of invoice line items per order item.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) as overall_average_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) as average_count_per_item FROM (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as ratio_avg, COUNT(*) as line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) per_item_stats
b.raw: For order items that have at least one invoice line item, calculate the average of derived_product_cost ÷ derived_total_cost across their invoice line items (excluding nulls) and count their invoice line items; return one row with the overall average of those per-item ratios and the average count of invoice line items per order item.

d.request: For each order item with at least one invoice line item, calculate the average of derived_product_cost ÷ derived_total_cost (skipping invalid ratios) and the count of associated invoice line items; then report the overall average ratio and overall average count across all such order items.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_average_ratio, AVG(item_count) AS overall_average_count FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Order_Items oi INNER JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) subquery

a.request: For each order item that appears in the invoice line items, take the average of `derived_product_cost` divided by `derived_total_cost` across its invoice line items (skipping missing ratios), and count its invoice line items. Then return one row with the average of those per-item average ratios (ignoring missing ones) and the average of those per-item line-item counts.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(per_item_avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios, AVG(per_item_count) AS avg_of_counts FROM (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) AS per_item_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS per_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) subquery

c.request: Per order item, work out the average of `derived_product_cost` ÷ `derived_total_cost` over its invoice line items (skipping missing ratios) and how many invoice line items it has. In a single row, what are the overall average of those per-item ratios (ignoring missing ones) and the average number of invoice line items per order item? Average over only the order items that have invoice line items.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(per_item_avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio, AVG(invoice_line_item_count) as avg_invoice_line_items_per_order_item FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as per_item_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as invoice_line_item_count FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) subquery WHERE per_item_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
